description:
Upgrade your 2023-2027 Honda HR-V or 2025-2026 Acura ADX with OEDRO Full Set Floor Mats. Engineered using precision digital laser scanning, these premium TPE liners provide a custom fit with front, rear, cargo, and seatback protection. Waterproof, odorless, and built for all seasons, they help defend your vehicle’s interior from spills, dirt, snow, and daily wear.
Features
Custom design for specific Models: OEDRO floor mats are precision engineered with advanced digital laser scanning for accurate interior coverage and a factory-style fit.
Complete Interior Protection with Full Set Coverage: The package includes front floor mats, rear floor liner, cargo liner, and seatback mats, helping protect your vehicle’s carpeted areas from dirt, spills, scratches, and everyday wear.
Premium TPE Material for All-Weather Performance: Made from high-density tri-extruded TPE material, these floor liners are waterproof, odorless, and free from harmful materials. They maintain flexibility in extreme temperatures while providing excellent wear resistance.
Deep Channels & Raised Edges Trap Messes: The advanced tray-style design helps contain water, mud, snow, sand, and debris, keeping your vehicle cleaner during daily commutes, outdoor trips, and changing weather conditions.
Anti-Slip Design & Easy Cleaning: Featuring a rugged textured surface and high-grip backing, these mats stay securely in place while providing reliable footing. The stain-resistant material can be quickly cleaned with a wipe or rinse for convenient maintenance.
2-years warranty. For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Fitment
Compatible with 2023-2027 Honda HR-V EX-L/LX/Sport (Gas & Hybrid models)
Compatible with 2025-2026 Acura ADX
Not compatible with HR-V models featuring vinyl flooring.
Not Compatible withAcura ADX with Bang & Olufsen Premium Sound System with 15 speakers
highlights: Premium Interior Protection: OEDRO Floor mats trap dirt, debris, and liquids to keep your vehicle floor clean and protected.
